provenance.crypto: Synthetic RustCrypto deterministic test keys/signatures; independently signed artifacts record their own tool provenance. No native crypto in the engine.
provenance.warning: Test-only PE/CFB/CAB containers and inert PowerShell scripts. Never execute these artifacts. Synthetic signing keys are public test constants; external fixtures have individual provenance. RDP fixtures use reserved example.invalid hosts; never open them in an RDP client.
provenance.interop_status: Synthetic PE/MSI corpus plus independently jsign 7.6-signed MSI and an unmodified upstream signtool fixture. Specific checks only; not full interoperability or Windows policy equivalence. CAB adds an independent jsign 7.6 signature and payload-tampered counterpart; limited standard-reserve layout only. PowerShell adds independently jsign 7.6-signed UTF-8 BOM, UTF-16LE, and UTF-16BE scripts and an isolated payload-tampered counterpart. RDP adds a pinned nfedera/rdpsign-produced detached signature and mutation counterparts; no Microsoft rdpsign.exe interoperability validation.
